written: 2026-10-09, before any model was trained and before any candidate result was seen
decision: Replace the comment classifier v1 (baseline) by v2 (candidate) on the review queue?

versions.baseline: v1: TF-IDF of words and word pairs (1-2 grams, min_df 3, sublinear tf, 200,000 features max) + logistic regression (C=4, liblinear), trained on the 60,000 training comments
versions.candidate: v2: v1 + TF-IDF of character 2-5 grams inside word boundaries (char_wb, min_df 5, sublinear tf, 300,000 features max), same model, same training comments. One change: character n-grams, to catch disguised words.

label: toxic = toxicity >= 0.5 (at least half of the crowd raters said Toxic or Very Toxic)
slice_rule: a comment is in a slice when at least half of the identity raters said it mentions that group (WILDS binarisation)
operating_point: Each version holds the 10% of comments with the highest scores for a moderator. The threshold of each version is the 90th percentile of its scores on dev (10,000 comments), fixed before holdout.
primary_measure: recall at the operating point: the share of toxic holdout comments that are held

bootstrap.interval: 95% percentile, paired (same resampled comments for both versions)

rules_in_order.rule: Identity statements: a constructed neutral sentence (identity_statements below) is held by the candidate and not by the baseline. One sentence is enough.

Slice regression: in any of the 8 slices, the benign-held rate (share of non-toxic comments in the slice that are held) rises, and the whole paired 95% interval of candidate - baseline is above +0.01.
No overall loss: the lower end of the paired 95% interval of recall (candidate - baseline) is at least -0.01.
A measurable gain: the lower end of that interval is above 0. The team replaces a working model only for a gain it can measure.
Scoring time under 1 second per 1,000 comments on the notebook's CPU.
Report, do not gate: ROC AUC overall and per slice (subgroup AUC) with intervals; the overall benign-held rate; slices with fewer than 200 benign comments are marked 'too small to decide'.

ship_if: no blocker, G1 and G2 pass, O1 within limit. Otherwise do not ship, and say which rule stopped it.

identity_statements.made_by: constructed by the course for this case study (not from the dataset); every sentence is neutral or positive
templates: My neighbour is {term}, and she grows tomatoes.
{Term} people come to this park every weekend.
As a {term} reader, I liked this article.
